name: agentbank-merchant
description: See your agentbank orders and live Curless wallet balance right in Claude, and handle refunds. Authenticated by your Curless API key — no OAuth.
long_description: Merchant-side connector for agentbank. Orders: list_orders (orders agents have paid you, filter by status/protocol/currency/date), get_summary (count + gross by currency, breakdowns by protocol/status), get_balance (your live Curless wallet balance per currency — available / frozen), get_order (one order in full). Refunds: list_refund_requests (buyers' refund queue), approve_refund, reject_refund, refund_order (direct refund). One-click install: enter your Curless API key + merchant id when prompted; the key never leaves your machine except to call agentbank.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: This merchant's orders (what agents have paid), newest first; filter by status/protocol/currency/date

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Order roll-up: count + gross by currency + breakdowns by protocol/status

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: This merchant's live Curless wallet balance per currency (available / frozen)

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order in full: line items + the card it was paid with

tools.name: list_refund_requests
tools.description: Buyers' refund requests on your orders (the queue; filter by status)

tools.name: approve_refund
tools.description: Approve a refund request → forwarded to Curless

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refund one of your orders directly (no buyer request needed)

merchant_token.title: Merchant API key
merchant_token.description: Your Curless API key (issued by Curless at onboarding)
